version.description: Schema metadata version per ADR-0016. Const v1 = initial baseline. Future bumps require version-migration flow.

$comment: DEPRECATED COPY — the canonical schema is _lib/schemas/skill_role_schema.json. Nothing loads this file (install.sh installs only the top-level _lib/), but it shares the same $id, so a tool resolving the $id could pick this stale copy and miss the `pattern` constraint on owns/not_owns. Keep in sync with the canonical file, or delete this one.
title: SkillRoleMetadata
description: Role metadata for phase skills: title, perspective, ownership boundaries, human involvement level. See ADR-0028.

title.description: Human-readable role name (bilingual: e.g., 'Architect (架构治理者)').

perspective.description: Thinking perspective for this phase (1-2 sentences).

not_owns.description: File paths this phase explicitly does NOT own.

human_involvement.description: Human involvement level per ADR-0003 gradient.
